title: Subaru High-z Exploration of Low-luminosity Quasars (SHELLQs). XII. Extended [C II] Structure (Merger or Outflow) in a z = 6.72 Red Quasar
question: Is the highest-redshift red quasar (z = 6.72) in a merger-driven to outflow-driven transition: what are its FIR continuum and extended [C II] properties, and is the extended [C II] structure companion/merging galaxies or a cold AGN-driven outflow?

data.angular_resolution: 0.77'' x 0.48'', P.A. = -58 deg (100 km/s cube, natural weighting)
data.sensitivity: 1 sigma channel rms 0.13 mJy/beam at 100 km/s; continuum 1 sigma = 17.6 uJy/beam

recipe.goal: Image the [C II] cube and FIR continuum
recipe.method: tclean with natural weighting; first clean cube including continuum to 3 sigma to find the line; integrate line-free channels into continuum map; subtract continuum in the uv plane with a first-order polynomial; average channels to 100 km/s
key_parameters: velocity resolution 100 km/s, channel rms 0.13 mJy/beam

recipe.goal: Measure the continuum flux density and source size
recipe.method: 2'' diameter circular aperture centred on the continuum peak for flux density; 2-D elliptical Gaussian fits with imfit for sizes
key_parameters: aperture diameter 2'' at the continuum peak

recipe.goal: Derive L_FIR, L_TIR, SFR_TIR and dust mass
recipe.method: optically-thin modified black body at fixed T_d and beta, with CMB correction; SFR from L_TIR calibration; dust mass from a mass absorption coefficient
key_parameters: T_d = 47 K, beta = 1.6; L_FIR over 42.5-122.5 um, L_TIR over 8-1000 um
assumptions: T_d = 35 K (local star-forming galaxies) would make luminosities ~2x smaller
SFR_TIR is an upper limit since all FIR emission is assumed to come from star formation (AGN contribution ignored)

recipe.method: single Gaussian then double Gaussian fit (core + wing) to the spectrum integrated within a 1.5'' radius of the nucleus where [C II] is detected above 3 sigma
assumptions: core component attributed to the host galaxy and used for the systemic redshift

recipe.goal: Derive [C II] luminosity, SFR and equivalent width
recipe.method: [C II] SFR from the core L_[CII] with a literature calibration; rest-frame EW from the [C II] core flux and the 1.2 mm continuum flux density
assumptions: SFR_[CII] is an upper limit because part of [C II] may come from the quasar narrow line region

recipe.goal: Characterize extended [C II] at positions A-C
recipe.method: spectra at three off-centre positions (A, B, C) give line centre, FWHM, flux and L_[CII]; extended structure judged real from several contiguous velocity channels

recipe.goal: Compare L_FIR with L_Bol of z>~6 quasars
recipe.method: L_Bol from 1450 A luminosity with a bolometric correction of 4.4; L_FIR derived with the same assumptions; linear fit of log L_FIR versus log L_Bol excluding upper limits; Spearman correlation
assumptions: J1205-0000 compared after its dust extinction is corrected

recipe.goal: Estimate outflow mass, rate, kinetic power and momentum load for blobs A-C
recipe.method: Mdot_out = M_out v_out / R_out with v_out = |dv| + FWHM/2; M_out from L_[CII] under the high-density limit (lower limit); kinetic power and momentum load from the standard formulae
assumptions: high density limit n >> n_crit, giving a lower limit on M_out
projection correction averages to unity over all angles; entire extended structure assumed to be outflow

recipe.goal: Constrain star formation in potential companions
recipe.method: 3 sigma upper limit on SFR_IR at the extended [C II] regions from undetected FIR continuum, with T_d = 35 K; compare with HSC y-band depth
